Regulatory Notice on AML Controls

The Authority has issued updated regulatory requirements for licensed firms. The notice requires enhanced AML and CTF controls, compliance attestations, and board-approved monitoring procedures.

Licensed firms must review customer due diligence controls, sanctions screening, suspicious activity escalation, and record retention obligations. The requirements apply from 1 July 2026.

Firms should document implementation evidence and maintain records for supervisory review. Questions should be directed to the official supervision department.
